gameName: Through the Ages: A New Story of Civilization

provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Through the Ages rulebook (Czech Games Edition, via RulesPal)

steps.text: 3 players: remove the three 4-player cards from each of civil decks I, II and III
2 players: remove the nine 3+/4 cards from each of civil decks I-III and all pact cards from military decks I-III
Shuffle the Age A military deck; {n} cards facedown as the current events deck; box the rest unseen
Shuffle the Age A civil deck; deal 13 faceup to the card row; rest on the light half of the current age board
Player board: a blue token on each of the 16 blue bank squares
Yellow tokens on the 18 yellow bank squares, the 6 squares of your starting technologies and the worker pool
4 white and 2 red tokens next to your Despotism card
Rating markers: science 1, culture 0, strength 1, happiness 0; points counters on 0
Tactics standard in the common tactics area
Choose a starting player (fixed for the game)
First-turn civil actions: white tokens on Despotism - 1 for the starting player, then 2, 3, 4 clockwise
No military actions on the first turn
The starting player takes the first turn; play is clockwise
